neighbours.label: a noun or position where a deficit word (depletion, loss, shortage, deficiency) is expected next
fire: Vegetarians who skip supplements are at risk of iron deficiency over time.
Lakes in hot summers can suffer severe oxygen depletion near the bottom.

Chemotherapy commonly causes temporary hair loss in many patients.
The country faces a serious water shortage after three dry winters.
Doctors tested the child for vitamin D deficiency after the fracture.
